versions.changelog: Make skill runtime-agnostic: align WAHOO_BASE_DIR defaults, remove OpenClaw-specific refs from published libs, add --limit flag, restore error reference table, fix SKILL.md doc errors, add requirements.txt
Throttle to 13s between requests (Wahoo sandbox: 25/5-min); revert per_page=30 to minimize total call count
Limit list API calls to per_page=1 to avoid rate limits
v0.1.8: full FIT capture — records, device_info, zones, session/lap gaps
Add lap splits extraction from FIT files into local SQLite DB
Security fixes: redact tokens in wahoo_auth.py __main__; pin fitparse dependency; exclude internal planning docs from bundle; expand README security guidance.

wahoo_auth.py auto-loads WAHOO_* vars from ~/.openclaw/secrets/wahoo.env when not already in env. Lets agents trigger sync without sourcing the env file. Explicit env still wins. $WAHOO_ENV_FILE overrides path.
Include MIT LICENSE.md in the published bundle.
